docs.title: Architecture sync 2026-05-05
docs.content:
Architecture Sync 2026-05-05

Participants: alice, bob, carol

alice: We're splitting the monolith. The normalizer code moves from prbe-knowledge into a new prbe-normalizer repo.
bob: Makes sense. prbe-knowledge is getting big.
carol: Timeline?
alice: Target is end of Q2. prbe-normalizer will have its own Fly app.

docs.title: ARCH-5: Extract the normalizer into prbe-normalizer repo
docs.content:
Issue ARCH-5: Extract the normalizer into a dedicated prbe-normalizer repository
Status: Planned
Description: Move services/ingestion/normalizer* from prbe-knowledge into a standalone prbe-normalizer repo. Deploy as a separate Fly app to allow independent scaling.

expected_edges.note: Meeting notes briefly mention the new prbe-normalizer repo as the target for the normalizer extraction migration
